narrative.overview: Mandate Mesh presents an uncompromising, high-assurance operational environment modeled on tactical aerospace telemetry consoles and cryptographic hardware security modules. The visual aesthetic is deliberately restrained, utilitarian, and high-density: every pixel is dedicated to verifiable state, cryptographic proofs, and deterministic guardrail status.
keyCharacteristics: High information density with monospaced data alignment for SHA-256 digests and currency values.
Flat structural depth through 1px border contrast and tonal substrate stepping.
Restrained, purposeful color economy (accents appear exclusively on verifiable state transitions).

rules.name: The Phosphor Economy Rule
rules.body: Functional accent colors (#34d399, #d03b3b, #d97706) must occupy <= 5% of any viewport. Chromatic intensity signals a state change; the resting canvas is cold monochrome slate.

rules.name: The Hash Distinctness Rule
rules.body: SHA-256 cryptographic digests, ECDSA signatures, and UUIDs are rendered in monospace typography inside recessed substrate wells (#0e1015) with a 1px border.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: All prices (paise / INR), timestamps (IST), and hash digests must render using monospace fonts with tabular alignment to ensure vertical column stability.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Doctrine
rules.body: No box-shadow or filter: drop-shadow is permitted on containers or surfaces. Depth is defined solely by perimeter borders and background contrast.

dos: Do enforce border-radius: 0px across every DOM element.
Do render all currency calculations as integer paise formatted to INR with two decimal places (e.g. ₹1,249.00).
Do format all ledger timestamps in Indian Standard Time (IST) with explicit +05:30 offset.
Do truncate SHA-256 hashes cleanly (e.g. 0x3a8f...9d12) with full string copy-to-clipboard affordances.
Do preserve the 48px compact Command Bar height for maximum vertical canvas economy.
donts: Don't introduce rounded corners, pill badges, or circular buttons.
Don't add decorative ambient glow, neon scanlines, or vibrating CRT animations that distract from telemetry reading.
Don't use floating-point math for any financial representation.
Don't use generic color names; rely on the semantic tokens defined in index.css.
Don't display unverified LLM output as authoritative state without passing through the cryptographic state machine.
